sentences.en: Recirculating aquacultural system has become the development trend for its high density, high resource utilization rate and sound benefit.
sentences.vi: Hệ thống nuôi trồng thủy sản tuần hoàn đã trở thành xu hướng phát triển vì mật độ cao, tỷ lệ sử dụng nguồn lợi cao và lợi ích hợp lý.

sentences.en: Aquacultural ponds are one of the types of artificial wetlands.

sentences.en: Dissolved inorganic nutrient (DIN) of the aquacultural environment is one of the main pollutions from aquaculture.

sentences.en: The pilot-scale have nine pools, the influent was from discharge channels containing aquacultural wastewater and community sewage near by Dapeng Bay. The experiment designs altogether has four stages.

sentences.en: No additional outlet for discharging sewage shall be allowed within marine sanctuaries aquacultural grounds and seashore scenic and tourist areas.

sentences.en: Hardy Utai brave the lower depths of the sinkhole grotto to use the water pools found there as a basis of aquacultural fields.
sentences.vi: Hardy Utai dũng cảm xuống độ sâu thấp hơn của hang động hố sụt để sử dụng các hồ nước được tìm thấy ở đó làm cơ sở cho các cánh đồng nuôi trồng thủy sản.

sentences.en: Pending settlement of the dispute, no party to the dispute may disrupt aquacultural production.
